market_summary: The pre-market setup is cautious to risk-off, based on 1669 articles from Yahoo Finance, TradingView, Seeking Alpha, The Motley Fool, Bloomberg.com. The dominant theme is macro, with 663 macro items, 550 company items, 420 industry items, and 36 policy items. The tape looks more useful for identifying near-term rotation and risk appetite than for making a single directional index call.
macro_summary: Late Cycle Slowdown Markets are balancing easier policy expectations against growth and earnings risk, keeping leadership narrow and confirmation dependent. The market is taking its direction from oil/energy, with investors testing whether policy support can offset slower growth and earnings risk. Macro coverage is concentrated around Fed/rates (176), inflation (107), oil/energy (101), growth/jobs (37). The practical implication is that equity rallies may need confirmation from rates and inflation expectations; if yields rise while growth headlines weaken, risk appetite can fade quickly.
risk_summary: Sentiment is cautious to risk-off: 211 positive, 267 negative, and 1191 neutral articles. My read is to avoid treating headline volume as conviction by itself; the more important signal is whether macro-sensitive and technology-sensitive stories are pointing in the same direction.
